commission_disclosures_scope_ck.name: commission_disclosures_scope_ck
commission_disclosures_scope_ck.value: (amc_id IS NOT NULL) <> (scheme_id IS NOT NULL)

consent_records_kind_pair_ck.name: consent_records_kind_pair_ck
consent_records_kind_pair_ck.value:
(kind = 'CHALLENGE' AND challenge_id IS NOT NULL AND document_key IS NULL AND subject_type IS NOT NULL)
        OR (kind = 'DOCUMENT_ACCEPTANCE' AND challenge_id IS NULL AND document_key IS NOT NULL AND subject_type IS NULL)

idempotency_keys_completed_has_response_.name: idempotency_keys_completed_has_response_ck
idempotency_keys_completed_has_response_.value: status = 'IN_PROGRESS' OR response_status IS NOT NULL

investor_profiles_gender_ck.name: investor_profiles_gender_ck
investor_profiles_gender_ck.value: gender IS NULL OR gender IN ('MALE', 'FEMALE', 'TRANSGENDER')

investor_profiles_occupation_ck.name: investor_profiles_occupation_ck
investor_profiles_occupation_ck.value: occupation IS NULL OR occupation IN ('BUSINESS', 'SERVICE_PRIVATE_SECTOR', 'SERVICE_PUBLIC_SECTOR', 'SERVICE_GOVERNMENT', 'PROFESSIONAL', 'AGRICULTURIST', 'RETIRED', 'HOUSEWIFE', 'STUDENT', 'FOREX_DEALER', 'OTHERS')

investor_profiles_income_slab_ck.name: investor_profiles_income_slab_ck
investor_profiles_income_slab_ck.value: income_slab IS NULL OR income_slab IN ('BELOW_1L', '1L_TO_5L', '5L_TO_10L', '10L_TO_25L', '25L_TO_1CR', 'ABOVE_1CR')

investor_profiles_source_of_wealth_ck.name: investor_profiles_source_of_wealth_ck
investor_profiles_source_of_wealth_ck.value: source_of_wealth IS NULL OR source_of_wealth IN ('SALARY', 'BUSINESS_INCOME', 'GIFT', 'ANCESTRAL_PROPERTY', 'RENTAL_INCOME', 'PRIZE_MONEY_OR_ROYALTY', 'OTHERS')

investor_profiles_pep_status_ck.name: investor_profiles_pep_status_ck
investor_profiles_pep_status_ck.value: pep_status IS NULL OR pep_status IN ('NOT_APPLICABLE', 'PEP', 'RELATED_PEP')

investor_profiles_tax_status_ck.name: investor_profiles_tax_status_ck
investor_profiles_tax_status_ck.value: tax_status IS NULL OR tax_status IN ('RESIDENT_INDIVIDUAL')

investor_profiles_address_nature_ck.name: investor_profiles_address_nature_ck
investor_profiles_address_nature_ck.value: address_nature IS NULL OR address_nature IN ('RESIDENTIAL', 'BUSINESS', 'RESIDENCE_CUM_BUSINESS')

nomination_decisions_display_pref_ck.name: nomination_decisions_display_pref_ck
nomination_decisions_display_pref_ck.value: decision <> 'NOMINATED' OR display_preference IS NOT NULL

nominees_minor_dob_ck.name: nominees_minor_dob_ck
nominees_minor_dob_ck.value: (NOT is_minor) OR (dob_enc IS NOT NULL AND guardian_name_enc IS NOT NULL)

nominees_pan_adult_ck.name: nominees_pan_adult_ck
nominees_pan_adult_ck.value: id_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'PAN' OR NOT is_minor

onboarding_applications_kyc_path_ck.name: onboarding_applications_kyc_path_ck
onboarding_applications_kyc_path_ck.value: kyc_path IS NULL OR kyc_path IN ('EXISTING_VALID', 'NONE')
